title: Remote Web Task Recipes
user: A low-vision or screen-reader user who must complete recurring tasks in browser-delivered remote or legacy software that exposes little usable accessibility metadata.
smallest_useful_product: A browser extension where a user or support worker records named, keyboard-reachable visual landmarks for one browser app and attaches concise spoken task steps. It uses user-triggered tab screenshots/OCR only to help place landmarks.
success_measure: In a five-task pilot, a participant completes at least four recurring tasks without sighted assistance after creating no more than ten landmarks.
constraints: Process screenshots locally and never upload page pixels or DOM text by default.
Require a deliberate user gesture before capture.
Do not claim compatibility with every remote desktop.
Do not automate clicks, capture credentials, or surveil employees.
